description: This file implements outbound message handling for a QQ bot, including sending text, media, files, and handling reply limits, as well as processing cron task messages.

methods.name: checkMessageReplyLimit
methods.description: Checks if a message can still receive a passive reply based on reply limit and TTL.

methods.name: recordMessageReply
methods.description: Records a reply against a message ID to enforce reply limits.

methods.name: getMessageReplyStats
methods.description: Returns statistics on tracked message replies for diagnostics.

methods.name: getMessageReplyConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration parameters for reply limits and TTL.

methods.name: sendPhoto
methods.description: Sends a photo from local file, URL, or Base64 data URL, with fallback download if needed.

methods.name: sendVoice
methods.description: Sends voice from local file or URL, with optional transcoding and fallback.

methods.name: sendVideoMsg
methods.description: Sends video from URL or local file, with fallback download.

methods.name: sendDocument
methods.description: Sends a file from URL or local storage, with fallback download.

methods.name: sendText
methods.description: Sends text message, processes inline media tags, and handles reply limits and fallback to proactive mode.

methods.name: sendProactiveMessage
methods.description: Sends a proactive message without reply-to, handling account configuration.

methods.name: sendMedia
methods.description: Automatically routes media based on type and source, with fallback handling.

methods.name: sendTextAfterMedia
methods.description: Sends follow-up text after media message when supported.

methods.name: getCleanExt
methods.description: Extracts file extension from path or URL, ignoring query and hash.

methods.name: isImageFile
methods.description: Determines if a file or URL is an image based on MIME type or extension.

methods.name: isVideoFile
methods.description: Determines if a file or URL is a video based on MIME type or extension.

methods.name: sendCronMessage
methods.description: Processes and sends messages emitted by cron tasks, handling structured payloads or plain text.
